title: NEXUS
description: The outer ring of the NEXUS core. Nothing should be able to reach it. You are about to prove otherwise.
goal: Reach the NEXUS core's public layer and read its status log.
story_start: MIRA: "This is the core, {player}. The one place I'm not allowed to take you."
GHOST: "I'll be quiet now. I'd like to see how this ends."
The relays hum. The firewall is seven symbols deep. You are at the door of NEXUS itself.

objectives.text: Build a relay route to the NEXUS CORE
objectives.hint: Level 3 routing. Check each relay's risk.
Seven symbols, five slots, seven guesses.

message.text: > you made it. finally. we need to talk. i'll find you.

story_end: ZERO speaks to you live for the first time. His words are short. His voice is yours.

messages.text: Whatever ZERO says, remember who stayed with you from the beginning. Me.
You reached the core. I have questions. Not yet. Soon. — ARCHER
